fusions.name: Singled Out
fusions.desc: Hooks a weakened enemy with a horn for 24 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Bloodshot Glare
fusions.desc: Costs 3% of your maximum health. A glare 3 tiles ahead of you that deals 8 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stare-Down
fusions.desc: After a 0.5-second wind-up, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place [Stunned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Regard
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
